aiDescription: Adds a sidebar plugin that passively rescans the current star system every 10 seconds or upon entry. It lists objects in the system without requiring an ability slot or hover action. This serves as a remake of the old object analysis tool.

gallery.aiCaption: A game menu titled 'Objects in system:' listing items like 'DERELICT SHIP (3)', 'DOMINION-ERA PROBE', and 'GALATIA GATE'.
